We assign an experienced estimator to carefully evaluate the vehicle and provide the customer with an accurate estimate of the costs involved, as well as information about insurance coverage. | 01 | Disassembly | Once we have the customer's approval to proceed with the repairs, we move on to disassembly if necessary. We carefully remove any damaged parts or components, such as exterior trim or interior panels, to access the areas that need repair. | 02 | Bodywork | Our skilled technicians then begin the bodywork process, using a variety of techniques such as welding, hammering, and sanding to restore the car's body to its original shape and contour. We take great care to ensure that the repairs are completed to a high standard so that the car looks as good as new. | 03 | Paint | Next comes the painting process. We carefully sand and prep the car for paint, and then we apply two base coats. We take pride in our ability to match our colors to the original OEM paint color of the car, and we always add three coats of clearcoat for protective and finishing durability. | 04 | Reassembly | Once the painting process is complete, we move on to reassembly. We reinstall any parts that were removed during disassembly and complete any final repairs, such as replacing damaged glass, repairing electrical systems, or aligning the wheels. Our goal is to ensure that the car is in perfect working order and looks as good as new when it leaves our shop. | 05 | Quality control | Finally, we conduct a thorough quality control inspection to ensure that all repairs have been completed to our high standards. We take great pride in delivering a well-maintained vehicle that runs like new, and our attention to detail is what sets us apart. When the car is ready for pick-up, we notify the customer and look forward to seeing them drive away in a car that's been expertly repaired and restored. | Insurance & Claims | We work with all insurance companies. | We work with all insurance companies and repair all types of body damage. Every repair is a promise: to restore your vehicle the right way. | Free Online Estimate | Call or Text | Our story | Honest, stress-free repair, done to factory standard | Wrecktified Paint & Collision is a trusted, family-owned auto body shop in Clearwater, FL, proudly serving drivers across the Tampa Bay area. Built on a foundation of integrity, craftsmanship, and customer care, Wrecktified delivers high-quality collision repair, auto body restoration, and paint and refinishing services for all makes and models. | Every vehicle is repaired by certified technicians using factory-approved parts, cutting-edge technology, and OEM-recommended repair methods. Whether it's a minor dent or a major collision, Wrecktified Paint & Collision is committed to restoring each vehicle to pre-accident condition: safely, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail. | As one of the top-rated collision repair centers in Tampa Bay, Wrecktified simplifies the repair process from start to finish. The shop offers free estimates, insurance claim assistance, and transparent communication throughout every stage of the repair. Each job is backed by our warranty, and the team walks every customer through it. | Wrecktified Paint & Collision has earned a reputation as one of the most reliable and professional auto body shops in Clearwater thanks to consistent five-star reviews and word-of-mouth referrals. The team takes pride in delivering honest, stress-free service that puts customers first, helping drivers get back on the road quickly and confidently. | More than just a body shop, Wrecktified stands for trust, precision, and professionalism.
